evidenceReviewContract.rule: Every ResearchData evidenceCandidate must be either referenced by evidenceUi.options[].sourceEvidenceIds or explicitly listed in evidenceReview.exclusions with a user-facing reason. Silent omission is forbidden.

exclusions.reason: Low practical value or duplicate evidence; explain why.

featureDispositionContract.rule: Every ResearchData feature must have exactly one explicit SelectionData feature decision. INCLUDE or EXCLUDE is required; silent omission is forbidden.
